title: PaymentCancelRequest
description: The input of payment.cancel: the canonical URI of the payment to cancel, and the version of that payment its caller decided on (step 21's README, decisions 4 and 5). This tutorial's own schema: the specification names payment.cancel and does not define its input. The pattern is the specification's resourceUri; the /payment/ part beside it is this tutorial's.

expected_version.description: The version of the payment that the caller read, and decided on. §38 names expected_version an argument of a tool (step 21's README, decisions 3 to 5). At most 2147483647, the largest version the database's integer column holds (step 21's README, decision 10).
